name: Solid Wood Soldiers
description: Neo-Nazi prison gang and organized crime syndicate based in Texas, founded during the 1990s by inmates within the Texas Department of Criminal Justice (TDCJ). Also known internally as 'The Wolfpack,' the gang is primarily involved in drug trafficking, assault, murder, and racketeering, with ties to other white supremacist groups. Their primary tattoo uses the SWS initials with lightning-bolt S's, a bear claw, the number 4 (representing Honor, Courage, Respect, and Loyalty), and the letters HCRL.
